# Import des données et libraries

```{r}
library(DescTools)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
data <- readRDS("data/df_joined.rds") 
```

```{r}
data_ratio <- data %>% select(WCTA, WCTA2, RETA, EBTA, TLTA, SLTA, NITA, CACL)
```

# Imputation

Avec la moyenne

```{r}
data[sapply(data, is.numeric)] <- lapply(
  data[sapply(data, is.numeric)],
  function(x) { x[is.infinite(x)] <- NA; x }
)

for (var in names(data_ratio)) {
  mean_val <- mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) 
  data[[var]][is.na(data[[var]])] <- mean_val 
}
```

# Winsorization

```{r}
data$WCTA_win <- Winsorize(data$WCTA, val= quantile(data$WCTA, probs = c(0.05, 0.95)))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = WCTA_win, color = factor(default3), fill = factor(default3))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Densité des valeurs selon defaults",
       x = "Valeurs",
       y = "Densité",
       color = "Defaults",
       fill = "Defaults") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Replace NA dans default3

```{r}
data$default3[is.na(data$default3)] <- 0
```

# Export

```{r}
saveRDS(data, "data/df_winsorized.rds")
```
